name: K-GEP-1 cementing job
notes: Fluid properties for the field case. These are placeholders until the real mud and slurry data are available - change any number here and rerun; nothing in the code needs editing. The drilling fluid is currently a light water-based mud; set tau0 to 0 and k to 1e-3 with n = 1 to make it water. The rat hole volume is the open hole below the casing shoe: it fills before the annulus starts to rise, so it delays every arrival by its volume over the pump rate. Zero here because it is unknown; Hart et al. (2025) had to estimate 10 m3 for their well.
